terms.gloss: a leaf, a sheet of paper: a tab (in a browser)
evidence: Cic. Fam. 15.16: quam tū scidam aut litteram
terms.comment: Classically a single leaf of papyrus or paper (also spelled scida); its use for one of the pages open side by side in a browser is modern, and ours, each tab being one leaf of a stack. No reference work has a word for it. The window itself is fenestella (see “window”).

phrases.latin: Tot schedae apertae sunt! Claude aliquot.
phrases.english: So many tabs open! Close a few.

sources: Lewis & Short: scida
